mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over a three-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC between UNRATE change and SPX returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor market is strong (PAYEMS > 149,000) and inflation is elevated (CPIAUCSL > 250), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250 and PAYEMS > 149000, or the Rank IC between the interaction term (PAYEMS * CPIAUCSL) and SPX returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 500,000), the S&P 500 tends to experience positive forward returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates, but this effect is muted during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 500,000, or the Rank IC between RSAFS and 60-day SPX returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 107.0 (a recent low) signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 107.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market, which typically supports corporate profit growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,150,000 units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1150, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of weak consumer spending (RSAFS) and declining housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based slowdown in the consumer sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS < 500000 and HOUST < 1150, or the Rank IC between the interaction term (RSAFS * HOUST) and SPX returns is below 0.05.
